description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Naga Fleshcrafter into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Naga Fleshcrafter dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Naga Fleshcrafter that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Naga Fleshcrafter token instead.
